title: Yezdi Adventure Rally Edition (Track Edition)
description: Representing Yezdi Motorcycles's prowess in the Adventure Tourer class, the Yezdi Motorcycles Yezdi Adventure Rally Edition (Track Edition) is tuned for uncompromising circuit performance with laser-guided cornering stability. Its tuned powertrain delivers immediate, tractable torque against a curb weight of 108 kg, ensuring responsive roll-on acceleration in demanding road conditions. With a commanding 855mm perch delivering excellent ground clearance and expansive sightlines and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
